name: aluvia-monorepo
description: Aluvia SDK monorepo - smart proxy for automation workloads and AI agents
author: Aluvia

scripts.publish:dry-run: npm publish --dry-run -w @aluvia/sdk && npm publish --dry-run -w aluvia && npm publish --dry-run -w @aluvia/mcp
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:cli && npm run build:mcp
scripts.test:all: npm test -w @aluvia/sdk && npm test -w aluvia && npm test -w @aluvia/mcp
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @aluvia/sdk && npm run lint -w aluvia
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w @aluvia/sdk && npm run lint:fix -w aluvia
